title: Page 7
content_zh:
“……”这算哪门子隐姓埋名的高手？死于他手下的那些冤魂，就算是想报仇雪恨，恐怕也还得先打听一下凶手姓啥名谁吧？

就在再莱他们聊天的此时此刻，奉了二师兄旨意前去替自家姊子出气的玄灵，已趁夜模入了灯火辉煌的西苑国皇宫。

没有惊动任何羽林军，甚至是在寝殿外头守夜的宫人们，玄灵手重一柄长剑，刚踏进寝殿外头，就以剑尖点住护卫着寝殿内室的几名武士，破了他们的气海后，笔直地进人内室里头，转身在门上落了锁。

被睡觉也不离身五步玩的两名相级高手推醒后，西苑皇帝惊慌失措地看着这名趁夜闯人皇宫的黑衣人。

“你……你究竟是何人！”

玄灵瞥他一眼，过了很久后才勉强开口。

“要你管！”

“……”这都杀到他睡觉的房门口了，他能不过问一下吗？

玄灵请冷的眸子缓锾睐起，手中墨色的长剑蓦地一动，西苑皇帝甚至都还没看清眼前发生什么事时，护在他身前的两名相级初阶护卫，两人的右手手臂便已腾空飞起，然后分别落在寝殿的左右两处。

寝殿地板上，铺设着珍贵的白雪虎皮，即刻被染上了大片斑斓的刺目血迹。

巧劲一甩，甩去了剑上的几滴血珠后，玄灵踩着无声的步伐，朝似被吓坏了的西苑皇帝一步步走来。

“你……你究竟是哪个门派的？”西苑皇帝哆哆嗦嗦地问，蹬着两腿直往睡□榻里头退，“朕、朕警告你……胆敢行刺干朕，西苑绝不会放过你的门派！”

玄灵的反应是……连个反应都欠奉，照旧板着一张俊容，走至床榻前再次扬起手中的长剑，伴随着西苑皇帝惊恐的尖叫声，一缕缕黑发在寝殿中四散飞扬。

一鼓作气斩了两位相级高手的手臂，也替西苑皇帝剃了个新发型后，玄灵一句话也不多说就离开了皇宫，任凭西苑皇帝呆呆坐在睡榻上，无言地看着一床被剃下的头发。

好半天，他终于回过神，伸手摸了摸顶上光溜溜的脑袋，在宫中羽林军纷纷赶来救驾时，忿忿地扯开了嗓门大吼。

“他到底是谁啊？”刚讲完她心目中最敬佩的三师兄后，再莱接过顾醒递过来的水杯，喝了几口润润喉，然后兴致很好地继续开讲。

“五师兄嘛”

赤水总算逮到个曾经听过的，“江湖上只知道容易是黄金门的，还有他一直都在找魂纸而已。”

“因为他行事得低调点，这是二师兄规定的。”她家五师兄一直都出不了风头也是没办法的事。

路露满心纳闷，“为何要低调？”怎么黄金门的门人落差都这么大？名声响遍全太陆的蓬菜，低调到从没听过的玄灵？到底是什么标准？

“他脾气不好。”全师门最冲动的就属他了。

“就这样？”

对于这点再莱也很无奈，她轻轻叹息。

“二师兄说，五师兄他要是再乱发脾气又丢黄金门的脸，那就把他的裸画拿去给四师姊印成小黄书。”五师兄怕死了屁股会被印在小黄书上头名扬天下，他能不收敛点吗？

“……”真恐怖的威胁。

而这时的容易，带着个甩不掉的跟班莫追，正在路国四周的众小国里，进行他们的替妹子出头大业。

总算有了理由可以不必克制睥气的容易，嚣张的气炀全开，一路踹破了诸小国的门，不管是皇宫大门、京城城门、各官府的府门，还是皇亲国戚的家门，只要是门扇大了点的，他全都踹破了泄愤。

而莫追则是在冷眼旁观之余，偶尔也助纣为虐一下。

利用易容术的他，顶着各国皇帝的脸，每到一国，就顺便以邻国皇帝的脸向此国扬言开战，根本就不管他替那些皇帝带来了多大的麻烦。

而说到名气跟蓬莱一般响亮的月穹，再莱的心情就好得不得了。

“四师姊？她人很好啊。”

哪儿好了啊？

目前西苑国国内，小黄书泛滥得有如一股肆虐的滔滔黄潮，听说西苑皇帝气得都上了天坛，去作法请玉旨诅咒月穹的祖宗十八代了。

“师姊她平常最爱写写画画了，她说她是个有抱负的斯文人。”于再莱的心中，月穹的形象和事实落差得……有那么一点点大。

“……”她的抱负就是用小黄书一统诸国？

再莱边说边点头，“还有她脾气也很好，对我都笑咪咪的。”

南贞国皇宫议事厅内，月穹扔开了手中的画笔，笑吟吟地走向南贞女皇，将最新出炉的一张裸男画拿给她过目。

“这张你觉得如何？”

被绑在椅子上的南贞女皇涨红了一张俏脸，恼恨地瞪着不知羞耻为何物的月穹。

她作梦也没想到，与南贞素来无怨的月穹会夜访皇宫，下毒毒昏了一整座皇宫的人，再闯进议事殿中，轻而易举地制住一室的人后，接着便？光了正在商议国事的众大臣，再大大方方地坐在议事桌上，开始替女皇旗下的一班老臣挥毫作画。

“怎么，不喜欢？”见她似乎不满意，月穹又换了一张，“那就是这张啦，瞧瞧，这尺寸多壮观啊。”

与一殿的人们相同，被点中哑穴不能言的南贞女皇，气得额上的青筋都一根根地浮现。

“听说你前阵子才死了个未婚夫，眼下正对下一任未婚去的人选犯愁？”月穹一副知情识趣状地拍在她的肩上，“有了这些画你日后就不必愁了，你瞧，重点我都替你画出来了，喜欢大的小的粗的细的长的短的统统都随你挑！”

如此无耻之徒……气红了眼的南贞女皇，恨不能冲上前去咬她个两口。

“别这么瞠我，我会以为你太感激我的。”月穹匀匀菱似的红唇，“对了，你也不必想着去黄金门找蓬莱告状，因我这回就是被他给派来的。”

“下回你家妹子想抢我师妹的男人前，可千万叫她想清楚了。”月穹弯下身在她耳边轻喃，顺手帮她解开了穴道。

第8章(2)

哑穴一解，南贞女皇便迫不及待地大喊。

“把他们的画还给朕！”居然……居然画了她南贞重臣们的裸画，这事要传出去了，她这女皇的颜面何存？

“不行。”月穹没得商？地摇首，“这些可都是我的肉票。”

“肉票？”

她一开始打的就是这主意，“想要的话，那就拿钱来赎，什么时候赎金到手了，我就什么时候把它还给你。”

“你！”南贞女皇被气得五脸六腑差点挪了位，而那些被画了大作的臣子，有些年事已高的，则是受不住地两眼一翻，一个接一个昏了过去。

月穹收好画作后，潇洒地对她挥挥手告别，“记得付赎金的速度要赶紧点啊，不然我要是不小心将它给印书上了，到时可别怪我没事先通知你！”

“月穹——”

大致将月穹从小到大干过的事都说过一遍后，再莱根本就没注意到其他人的面色有多古怪，还兴致勃勃地准备继续开讲。

“接下来的就是我的师弟妹们了。”

“别再说了，我们不想知道更多了……”一群听众奄奄一息，无力地对她摆摆手。

“我说错了什么？”再莱拉拉顾醒的衣袖。

“没有。”只是实话总是很伤人，也很毁灭他们对黄金门的印象而已。

路露几乎是以崇敬的眼神看着她，“小莱，你师门是坐落在什么龙渭虎穴上吗？或者是在什么钟灵毓秀的地方？”

“就很普通的山头啊。”

"..." What kind of master is this who is anonymous?Even if they want to seek revenge for the unjust souls who died at his hands, I'm afraid they still have to find out the name of the murderer first, right?

At the moment when Zai Lai and the others were chatting, Xuan Ling, who had gone to vent his anger on his sister's behalf at the behest of his second senior brother, had taken advantage of the night to enter the brightly lit Xiyuan Palace.

Without alerting any of the Yulin troops, or even the palace people who were watching outside the dormitory, Xuanling held a long sword in his hand. As soon as he stepped outside the dormitory, he used the tip of his sword to point the few warriors guarding the inner chamber of the dormitory. After breaking their air, he walked straight into the inner room, turned around and locked the door.

After being pushed awake by two prime ministers who never left his side while sleeping, Emperor Xiyuan looked at the man in black who broke into the palace at night in panic.

"You...who are you!"

Xuan Ling glanced at him and reluctantly spoke after a long time.

"I want you to take care of it!"

"..." This has reached the door of the room where he sleeps. Can he not ask?

Xuan Ling Qing Leng's eyes slowly narrowed, and the ink-colored long sword in his hand suddenly moved. Before Emperor Xiyuan could even see clearly what was happening in front of him, the right arms of the two prime minister-level guards guarding him flew up into the air, and then landed on the left and right sides of the dormitory respectively.

The floor of the dormitory was covered with precious snow-white tiger skin, which was immediately stained with large, colorful and dazzling blood stains.

With a clever flick, Xuan Ling shook off a few drops of blood on the sword, and walked towards the frightened Emperor Xiyuan step by step with silent steps.

"You...which sect are you from?" Emperor Xiyuan asked tremblingly, kicking his legs and retreating to the sleeping couch, "I, I warn you...if you dare to assassinate me, Xiyuan will never let your sect go!"

Xuan Ling's reaction was... He didn't even have a reaction. He still wore a handsome face, walked to the bed and raised the long sword in his hand again. Along with Emperor Xiyuan's frightened scream, strands of black hair were scattered in the bedroom.

After cutting off the arms of two prime ministers in one go and giving Emperor Xiyuan a new haircut, Xuan Ling left the palace without saying a word, leaving Emperor Xiyuan sitting on the couch in silence, looking at the shaved hair on the bed.

After a long while, he finally came to his senses, reached out and touched his bare head, and yelled angrily at the top of his voice when the Yulin troops in the palace rushed to rescue him.

"Who is he?" After just finishing talking about the third senior brother she admired the most, Zai Lai took the water glass handed over by Gu Xing, took a few sips to moisten her throat, and then continued her lecture with great interest.

"Fifth senior brother"

Chishui finally caught someone he had heard before, "The only people in the world who know Yi Yi is from the Golden Gate, and he has been looking for the soul paper."

"Because he acts in a low-key manner. This is the rule of the second senior brother." There is no way that her fifth senior brother has always been unable to be in the limelight.

Lu Lu was puzzled, "Why do you have to keep a low profile?" Why are there such big differences among the disciples of the Golden Gate?Peng Cai, who is famous all over the continent, and Xuan Ling, who is so low-key that he has never heard of it?What is the standard?

"He has a bad temper." He is the most impulsive in the whole division.

"That's it?"

Zai Lai was helpless at this point, and she sighed softly.

"The second senior brother said that if the fifth senior brother loses his temper again and embarrasses the Golden Gate, then he will take his nude paintings to the fourth senior sister and print them into a pornographic book." The fifth senior brother is scared to death that his butt will be printed in the pornographic book and become famous all over the world. Can he not restrain himself?

"..." What a terrifying threat.

But at this time, Jianyang, with a follower Mo Zhui who couldn't get rid of him, was in the small countries around the Lu country, carrying out their great mission of standing up for the girl.

Finally having a reason, he didn't have to restrain his arrogance. With all his arrogance, he kicked down all the doors of small countries. Whether it was the palace gate, the capital city gate, the gates of various government offices, or the homes of the emperor's relatives, as long as the doors were a little too big, he kicked them all to vent his anger.

Mo Zhui, on the other hand, watched with cold eyes and occasionally helped the villain.

He used the art of disguise to face the emperors of various countries. Whenever he visited a country, he would threaten the country to start war in the face of the neighboring emperors, regardless of how much trouble he caused for those emperors.

When it comes to Yue Qiong, whose reputation is as loud as Penglai's, Zai Lai's mood is extremely good.

"Fourth Senior Sister? She is very nice."

What's better?

At present, in the Xiyuan Kingdom, the number of yellow books is overflowing like a raging yellow tide. I heard that the Emperor of Xiyuan was so angry that he went to the Temple of Heaven and went to ask Yue to curse the eighteenth generation of Yue Qiong's ancestors.

"Senior sister, she usually loves to write and draw. She said that she is an ambitious and gentle person." In Yu Zailai's heart, the gap between Yue Qiong's image and reality was... a little bit big.

"..." Her ambition is to use the Little Yellow Book to unify all the countries?

Zailai nodded as he spoke, "She also has a good temper, and she always smiles at me."

In the meeting hall of Nanzhen Palace, Yue Qiong threw away the paintbrush in her hand, walked towards Queen Nanzhen with a smile, and showed her the latest painting of a naked man.

"What do you think of this one?"

Queen Nanzhen, who was tied to a chair, blushed and glared angrily at Yue Qiong, who didn't know what shame was.

She never imagined that Yue Qionghui, who had never had any grudges with Nanzhen, would visit the palace at night, poison an entire palace, and then break into the meeting hall and easily subdue a room of people. What next?After all the ministers were discussing state affairs, they sat on the discussion table openly and began to paint pictures for a group of senior ministers under the Queen's banner.

"What, you don't like it?" Seeing that she seemed dissatisfied, Yue Qiong changed another picture, "That's this one. Look, the size is so spectacular."

Like the people in the first hall, Queen Nanzhen, who was hit in the mute point and could not speak, was so angry that the veins on her forehead appeared one by one.

"I heard that your fiancé just died a while ago, and you are now worried about who to marry next?" Yue Qiong patted her on the shoulder with a knowing look, "With these paintings, you don't have to worry about it in the future. You see, I have drawn all the key points for you. You can choose whatever you like, big, small, thick, thin, long or short!"

Such a shameless person... Queen Nanzhen, whose eyes were red with anger, wished she could rush forward and bite her twice.

"Don't glare at me like that, I will think you are too grateful to me." Yue Qiong's evenly red lips said, "By the way, you don't have to think about going to the Golden Gate to complain to Penglai, because I was sent here by him this time."

"Next time your sister wants to steal my junior sister's man, be sure to ask her to think clearly." Yue Qiong bent down and whispered in her ear, and smoothly opened her acupuncture points.

Chapter 8(2)

As soon as the mute point was released, Queen Nanzhen couldn't wait to shout.

"Return their paintings to me!" Actually... she actually painted naked paintings of her Nanzhen ministers. If this matter is going to be spread, how can she, the empress, have any dignity?

"No." Yue Qiong didn't agree?He shook his head, "These are my meat tickets."

"Meat ticket?"

This was what she had in mind from the beginning, "If you want it, then use the money to ransom it. When the ransom is received, I will return it to you."

"You!" Queen Nanzhen was so angry that she almost moved her position. Some of the courtiers who had been painted with masterpieces, some of whom were very old, rolled their eyes unbearably and fainted one after another.

After Yue Qiong put away the painting, he waved goodbye to her gracefully, "Remember to pay the ransom quickly, otherwise if I accidentally print it in a book, don't blame me for not notifying you in advance!"

"Moon Dome——"

After roughly telling everything Yue Qiong had done since he was a child, Zai Lai didn't even notice how strange the other people's faces were, and he was still excited to continue talking.

"The next ones are my junior brothers and sisters."

"Stop talking, we don't want to know more..." A group of audience members were dying and waved their hands to her feebly.

"What did I say wrong?" Zailailaila pulled Gu Xing's sleeves.

"No." It's just that the truth always hurts people and destroys their impression of the Golden Gate.

Lu Lu looked at her with almost reverence, "Xiao Lai, is your school located on some kind of dragon, tiger, and tiger's den? Or is it in some beautiful place?"

"It's just an ordinary hilltop."
